blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Being the No. 1 team in Group B of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup would look like a reward for a Magnolia side that bucked a slow start to go on a string of victories. Instead, the Hotshots will have to go through the TNT Tropang 5G in a best-of-five crossover quarterfinal series that puts coach LA Tenorio’s squad in a massive roadblock to begin their quest to go deep. “The prize of being No. 1 is facing TNT and RHJ (Rondae Hollis-Jefferson),” Tenorio said with a smile after Magnolia’s 107-103 victory over Rain or Shine on Wednesday at Ynares Center […]...
